edit.text: Miguel travels to Earth-67 to explain the multiverse to its Spider-Man. Instead the two get stuck arguing and pointing at each other.
edit.whoA: Earth-67's Spider-Man, who ends up arguing with Miguel.

add.title: Daredevil S1
add.text: Brett Mahoney is an NYPD friend who helps Karen and her friends from inside the department.
add.whoA: A friend Mahoney helps from inside the NYPD.
add.whoB: An NYPD friend who helps Karen.

edit.text: Cole North escorts a blindfolded Kirsten McDuffie into the Freeport complex, where she tells him that limiting Jack Duquesne's access to counsel is illegal.
edit.whoA: A lawyer who tells North that limiting Duquesne's access to counsel is illegal.
edit.whoB: The officer who escorts Kirsten into Freeport and limits her time with Duquesne.

edit.text: Buck Cashman oversees Daniel Blake on Fisk's staff. After Blake lets BB Urich escape, Cashman tortures him, and when Blake refuses to say where she is, Cashman kills him.

Diamondback attacks the clinic where Misty has found Luke, beats the wounded Luke and drags Misty outside as a hostage. He takes her gun, holds it to her head and demands that she beg, but she refuses.
Robbie Robertson is an editor at the Bugle, where Peter sells his photos, and one of the few there who sees Spider-Man as a hero.
Once Mariah is arrested, Rosalie turns against her and moves in on Harlem.

add.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
add.text: After winning the election for mayor, Fisk tells Vanessa he knows she had an affair with a man named Adam while he was away.
add.whoA: Vanessa's husband and partner in crime, who learns of her affair with Adam.
add.whoB: Fisk's wife and partner in crime, who had an affair while he was away.

add.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
add.text: Vanessa dies in hospital of the head wound from Fisk's boxing match, after asking him again and again to tell the story of how they met.
add.whoA: Vanessa's husband and partner in crime, at her side when she dies.
add.whoB: Fisk's wife and partner in crime, who dies of a head wound from his boxing match.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
add.text: Fitz learns Radcliffe is behind Aida's attack, and Jemma joins the team that arrests him at his home. The man they take turns out to be his android double.
add.whoA: Scientist who works with Radcliffe to save May, then helps arrest him.
add.whoB: Scientist Jemma works with to save May, until he turns on S.H.I.E.L.D.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
add.text: Jemma and Fitz seek out Radcliffe for help against Hive, and Jemma sees through his fake-eye test. Then Daisy and Hive's followers burst in and take him.
add.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who sees through Radcliffe's fake-eye test.
add.whoB: Transhumanist scientist Jemma seeks out for help against Hive.

edit.text: As Silvermane's top scientist, Alistair kidnaps the Black Cat and forces Spider-Man to bring him the DNA of the Scorpion or the Vulture to win her release.

edit.whoA: A former Oscorp intern, secretly Spider-Man, who quits and stops trusting Norman.
edit.whoB: Peter's former mentor at Oscorp, whose lies cost him Peter's trust.

add.title: X-Men: First Class
add.text: Moira brings Charles to the CIA, and they lead the mission against Shaw together. Afterward she promises to keep his school secret, but he wipes her memory.
add.whoA: CIA officer who works with Charles against Shaw. He wipes her memory.
add.whoB: Telepath who leads the mission against Shaw with Moira. Wipes her memory.
